_comment: Macros that ship WITH the app, so they survive a reinstall and never have to
be re-trained by voice. Every step below was derived by driving the real apps
over ADB on a 1264x2780 device and reading the accessibility tree - the labels
are the exact text/content-description each control publishes.
RULES if you edit this file:
- Prefer tap_text (label lookup) over tap_coordinates. Control positions move
with keyboard state; labels do not.
- For anything whose duration varies (image/video generation) use
- A step that is only sometimes applicable (resetting an app that may already
be clean) needs "_optional": true, or a normal run ends in the semantic
fallback and Maya improvises her way into unrelated apps.
- Bump "version" to push edits onto installs that already seeded.

macros.name: chatgpt image
macros.intent: ChatGPT app me image generate karo aur gallery me save karo

steps._why: ChatGPT reopens on whatever screen it was left on. Without this reset the chat still holds older replies, EVERY message row has its own 'Share', and tap_text hits the FIRST one - the old text answer, whose share sheet has no 'Download'. 'New chat' only exists once a conversation is open, so it is optional: on an already-clean screen the step is skipped, not failed.
Generation takes 20-90s depending on load, so watch the progress label instead of guessing a duration.

macros.name: gemini image
macros.intent: Gemini app me Images tool se image banao aur gallery me save karo

steps._why: Opens the lightbox, whose Save button is unambiguous - unlike the in-chat row.

macros.name: gemini video
macros.intent: Gemini app me Videos tool se video banao aur save karo

steps._why: Veo/Omni takes anywhere from ~1 to ~8 minutes for the SAME prompt. This is exactly why wait_for_screen_text exists - a fixed wait either gives up early or burns minutes on every run.
Two controls carry the description 'More options' (the message row and the top bar). The message-row one comes first in the node tree, which is what findBestByLabel returns.
